headline: Screening Committee votes to recommend 3 to 5 candidates for Budget/Management Analyst to full City Council and enters executive session to review applications.
summary: The committee elected Spang as Vice Chair and Rotondo as Clerk, then discussed how to screen candidates for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position with input from current analyst Gerald Perry. Members agreed on confidentiality protocols for applicant materials and voted to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full Council before entering executive session to begin reviewing resumes.
decisions: Elected Danielle Spang as Vice Chair of the Preliminary Screening Committee, 3-0.
Elected Todd Rotondo as Clerk of the Preliminary Screening Committee, 3-0.
Decided to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full City Council for review, 3-0.
Approved a brief recess of up to five minutes, 3-0.
Voted to enter Executive Session to consider applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position, 3-0 by roll call.

decision_evidence.quote: Rotondo nominates Spang to serve as Vice Chair; Houseman seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
Houseman nominates Rotondo to serve as Clerk; Spang seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
Rotondo motions to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full Council for review; Spang seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
Houseman moves for a brief up to five (5) minute recess; seconded by Rotondo; the motion carries 3-0.
Rotondo moves to enter Executive Session; Spang seconds; Houseman takes a roll-call vote (Rotondo-yes; Spang-yes; Houseman-yes), and the motion carries 3-0 at 10:15 a.m.
